title: Art manifest slot, version 1
description: What this is: the shape of one slot in an art manifest. A slot is one place a picture goes, and the manifest lists every slot under 'slots'. Why it exists: the list people read is built from this data, so it cannot drift from what the pages show. How to use it: write each slot to this shape; scripts/art-manifest.mjs checks it and writes the list. Next step: add a field here before you add it to a slot. Uses only type, enum, minLength, items and additionalProperties, so small checkers can read it.

src.description: the file the slot shows now, as a path from the project root

alt.description: the alt text a screen reader says; an empty string marks a picture that only decorates

alternates.description: kept versions that are not shown now; swap one in by changing src

source.description: where the art came from, in a few words

carries.description: what the slot has to show, one item each

status.description: placeholder means no art yet: the page shows a labelled empty box. Leave it out when the slot shows src

label.description: the words a placeholder box shows

purpose.description: what the slot is for, in plain words

section.description: the page or part of a page the slot sits in

cast.description: who is in the picture; names only as {{id}} tokens from the character registry

layout.description: how the picture sits on the page: size, crop, what overlaps it

record.description: the path to the slot's made-by record or brief, when it lives in its own file
